capabilities: Synchronize vault files with a self-hosted Private Sync Server over HTTP/HTTPS
Pair devices and manage server vaults, approvals, and storage from a sidebar view
Resolve file conflicts and browse file revision history
Sync selected Obsidian settings and community plugin settings across devices
Encrypt selected notes client-side with a separate encryption password
extras: The manifest description carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' The server backend is a separate component set up with syncctl and is not included in the plugin itself.
motivation: The README emphasizes that the plugin has no author-hosted default cloud and sends no data to external services, indicating the author wanted a privacy-focused, self-hosted sync option.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync relies on a paid hosted service, while some users want to sync their vault through their own server without sending data to a third-party cloud.

relations.evidence: synchronizes an Obsidian vault with a self-hosted Private Sync Server backend

summary: Self-hosted sync client that synchronizes an Obsidian vault with a user-run Private Sync Server, including settings and plugin settings.
